title: Don't buy it if you live in California...
text:
Don't buy it if you live in California.... This Toshiba Purifier is a rebadge of the Eureka Instant Clear 26' Air Purifier. They are identical products, different brand name. So the most pressing question everyone has is... "Which filter and where do I buy them?" You can buy them here on Amazon. You should replace the True Hepa Filter once every 12 months, search for model: NEA-F1.
You should also replace the Carbon Pre-Filter every 3 months, search for model: NEA-C1

However, if you live in California, I would skip this model and avoid the confusion and headache. First of all, there is no Toshiba branded filters. It's quite annoying you have to go treasure hunting for info. The manual recommends changing filters, but does not indicate where or how to get them. That's because there isn't any officially made for Toshiba. On top of this annoyance, is the fact that many sellers won't ship the filters, mentioned above, to California. I guess they didn't pass certain regulations for California, but they'll sell the Purifier itself to Californians. Makes no sense.

product_metadata.title: Toshiba Air Purifier CAF-W36USW UV Light Sanitizer, Designed for Smoke, Dust, Odors, Pollen and Pet Hair for Home, Office, Bedroom, Black
features: 【High-Efficiency Filtration】This Toshiba Air Purifier includes 3 filters (Pre-filter, HEPA filter, Activated carbon) to capture 99.97% of airborne particles 0.3 microns such as smoke pets dander, mold, pollen, allergen, and dust from the air.
【Ideal Air Purifier for Home】Air purifier works in medium to large rooms up to 222 sq. ft. 3 speed setting from low to high speed will satisfy different demands.
【Powerful UV Light Sanitizer】Kills germs and airborne viruses such as influenza, staph, and rhinovirus, UV air purifier create a healthy environment for you and your family.
【Quiet Operation 】 As low as 32dB under Sleep mode, you can sleep in a restful and soothing indoor environment.

【Alexa Capability 】 Toshiba Smart Air Purifier can be turned on and off through Alexa App or any Echo device through voice control. It makes it easier to purify the air in your home from anywhere with just one command.

【Compatible Filters 】 The dash program will send reminders from the Alexa App when the filter needs to be replaced. Choose Toshiba HEPA filter (to be replaced every 12 months) and Toshiba activated carbon filter (to be replaced every 3 months) (filter replacement)

【AHAM & Energy Star Certified】Professional certified for your safety. Complies with California Air Resources Board (CARB) for indoor cleaning devices. The Intertek Testing Service certificated that Toshiba CAF-W36USW Air Purifier satisfied the requirements of EPA Energy Star.
